description: Legal AI market ontology. Facet A (workflow domain -> category) is the mind-map tree; facets B-D are cross-cutting filters. Derived bottom-up from ~1,900 distinct capability phrases in company profiles, then grouped by the legal workflow they serve.

A_domain.label: Workflow domain (what job the product does)

categories.name: Case law & statute research
categories.def: Search and Q&A over case law, statutes, regulations with cited answers.

categories.name: Citation checking & brief validation
categories.def: Verify citations, detect hallucinated authorities, cite-check briefs, Bluebook formatting.

categories.name: Knowledge management & precedent search
categories.def: Search a firm's own documents/know-how, precedent banks, expertise location, enterprise search for legal.

categories.name: Legal publishers & content platforms
categories.def: Proprietary legal content libraries (publishers) with AI layers: treatises, practical guidance, news.

categories.name: Legal education & training
categories.def: Bar prep, CLE, law-school and lawyer skills training using AI.

categories.name: General legal AI assistant / copilot
categories.def: Horizontal chat-style assistant for many legal tasks (Q&A, drafting, summarizing, analysis).

categories.name: Bulk document analysis & tabular review
categories.def: Run questions across hundreds/thousands of documents, extract into tables/grids.

categories.name: Agentic workflows & no-code legal app builders
categories.def: Build/run multi-step legal agents and workflows; no-code automation for legal teams.

categories.name: Word/Outlook embedded drafting tools
categories.def: AI inside Microsoft Word/Outlook for drafting, defined terms, cross-references, proofreading.

categories.name: Document automation & assembly
categories.def: Template-driven document generation, questionnaires, clause assembly.

categories.name: Legal writing & memo drafting
categories.def: Drafting memos, letters, opinions, emails; writing quality/style tools.

categories.name: Contract drafting & negotiation
categories.def: Draft contracts, redline, negotiate against playbooks, suggest fallback clauses.

categories.name: Contract review & risk analysis
categories.def: AI review of contracts against playbooks/standards; NDA review; risk flagging.

categories.name: CLM, repository & obligation management
categories.def: Contract lifecycle workflows, repositories, approvals, obligations, renewals.

categories.name: Contract data extraction & analytics
categories.def: Extract metadata/clauses from contract portfolios; analytics; legacy migration; abstraction.

categories.name: Self-serve contracting & e-signature
categories.def: Business-user contract generation, standard agreements, e-signing.

categories.name: M&A due diligence & data rooms
categories.def: Diligence review, red-flag reports, virtual data rooms with AI.

categories.name: Deal & closing management
categories.def: Closing checklists, signature packets, transaction workflows, deal precedent analysis.

categories.name: Entity management & corporate governance
categories.def: Entity records, board minutes, resolutions, corporate secretarial, cap tables.

categories.name: Private funds & financial documents
categories.def: Fund formation docs, NDAs/side letters for private markets, loan/credit docs, ISDA.

categories.name: Real estate & lease abstraction
categories.def: Lease review/abstraction, title & property legal work.

categories.name: eDiscovery & document review
categories.def: Processing, TAR/predictive coding, GenAI first-pass review, privilege, production.

categories.name: Case analysis & fact development
categories.def: Chronologies, case file Q&A, fact extraction, early case assessment, case strategy.

categories.name: Litigation drafting
categories.def: Pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery requests/responses, complaints.

categories.name: Depositions, transcripts & trial prep
categories.def: Deposition prep/summaries, transcription, exhibits, jury research, trial presentation.

categories.name: Litigation analytics & outcome prediction
categories.def: Judge/court analytics, docket data, outcome prediction, litigation risk scoring.

categories.name: Arbitration & dispute resolution
categories.def: International arbitration research, ODR, AI arbitration, settlement platforms.

categories.name: Case origination & litigation finance
categories.def: Detect legal violations/claims, mass-tort origination, litigation funding decisions.

categories.name: Medical record review & chronologies
categories.def: Summarize/organize medical records, treatment gaps, medical chronologies.

categories.name: Demand letters & case valuation
categories.def: Draft demand packages, estimate damages/settlement value.

categories.name: Benefits & insurance claims
categories.def: SSDI, workers comp, insurance claim/coverage analysis.

categories.name: Patent search, prior art & analytics
categories.def: Prior-art, novelty, FTO, invalidity, landscaping, patent analytics.

categories.name: Patent drafting & prosecution
categories.def: Draft specifications/claims, office-action responses, invention disclosures.

categories.name: Trademark search, filing & watch
categories.def: Clearance search, filing, watch services, goods/services classification.

categories.name: IP portfolio management & docketing
categories.def: IP management systems, docketing, annuities, portfolio valuation.

categories.name: Infringement detection & brand protection
categories.def: Detect infringement/counterfeits, evidence of use, takedowns, licensing.

categories.name: Regulatory change monitoring
categories.def: Horizon scanning, regulatory alerts, regulatory intelligence.

categories.name: Obligation & policy mapping
categories.def: Extract obligations from rules; map to policies/controls; gap analysis.

categories.name: Compliance review agents
categories.def: AI agents that review marketing, communications, transactions or documents for regulatory compliance.

categories.name: Privacy, data protection & AI governance
categories.def: DPA review, privacy ops, AI risk governance & AI-law compliance.

categories.name: Investigations & communications surveillance
categories.def: Internal investigations, comms surveillance, misconduct risk.

categories.name: Legal front door, intake & triage
categories.def: Route and triage requests from the business; ticketing for legal.

categories.name: Matter, spend & e-billing management
categories.def: Matter management, outside-counsel spend, invoice review, budgeting.

categories.name: Self-service legal for business teams
categories.def: Answer business teams' legal questions and generate approved docs without lawyers.

categories.name: Practice & case management
categories.def: Matter/case management systems, tasks, calendars, firm workflows.

categories.name: Time capture, billing & finance
categories.def: AI time capture, billing narratives, trust accounting, firm financials.

categories.name: Client intake, CRM & marketing
categories.def: Lead qualification, AI receptionists, CRM, legal marketing/SEO.

categories.name: Client communication & portals
categories.def: Client portals, automated updates, client messaging.

categories.name: Document & email management (DMS)
categories.def: Legal document management systems, email filing, records.

categories.name: Docketing & deadline calendaring
categories.def: Court-rules-based deadline calculation, docket monitoring.

categories.name: Firm intelligence & business development
categories.def: Pricing, profitability, pitch/BD intelligence, relationship mapping.

categories.name: Consumer self-help legal
categories.def: DIY legal documents/Q&A for individuals and small businesses.

categories.name: Estate planning & family law
categories.def: Wills, trusts, probate, divorce, custody.

categories.name: Immigration
categories.def: Visa eligibility, petitions, RFE responses, immigration case management.

categories.name: Legal marketplaces & lawyer matching
categories.def: Match clients with lawyers, flat-fee legal services platforms.

categories.name: Access-to-justice & legal aid tools
categories.def: Tools for legal aid orgs, self-represented litigants, record clearance, eviction defense.

categories.name: Judicial & court AI
categories.def: Tools for judges/clerks/courts: bench memos, court transcription, case management.

categories.name: Criminal justice & public defense
categories.def: Body-cam/evidence review for defenders/prosecutors, risk assessment.

categories.name: Government legal & legislative drafting
categories.def: Legislative drafting, policy tracking, government legal departments.

categories.name: AI-native law firms
categories.def: Licensed law firms delivering legal services with AI at the core (flat fee/outcome pricing).

categories.name: Tech-enabled ALSPs & managed services
categories.def: Alternative legal service providers/managed review/legal process outsourcing using AI.

categories.name: Legal LLMs, embeddings & models
categories.def: Legal-domain foundation models, embeddings, rerankers.

categories.name: Legal data & APIs
categories.def: Case law/docket/legislation data APIs, open legal data.

categories.name: Evaluation, security & trust tooling
categories.def: Benchmarks/evals for legal AI, hallucination testing, secure deployment.

values.name: Horizontal AI platform
values.def: Broad legal AI workspace serving many tasks/practice areas.

values.name: Point solution
values.def: Focused product for one workflow or vertical.

values.name: Incumbent suite / publisher
values.def: Established legal software or content company adding AI to an installed base.

values.name: AI-native services
values.def: Law firm or ALSP that sells outcomes/services powered by AI.

values.name: Infrastructure
values.def: Models, data, APIs or evaluation sold to builders.
